messages:
meera (eng-sre): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a compact action tracker for the streaming/chat reliability issues (timeouts, partial responses, reconnect logic). I sketched items below, pls react/assign. Goal: reduce user-facing partial responses by 90% in 4w.

ops-bot: Postmortem doc uploaded: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-streaming-chat.json :document:

alex (eng-runtime): Ack. I'll take lead on reconnect/backoff changes. Plan: add jittered exponential backoff + cap total retries per call, and expose retryable error categories upstream.

jordan (eng-platform): I'll own infra-side keepalive and load-shedding rules. Hypothesis: overloaded workers drop streams leading to partial responses. I'll add a short-circuit that returns 503 before partial write.

sam (eng-ml): I'll add model-side telemetry for early-termination cases and a sampling hook to capture the last 2KB of the token stream when partial responses occur. Need a small quota bump for traces.

meera (eng-sre): Nice. Concrete checklist: 
- [ ] Instrument partial_response counter (per-model, per-route) — owner: sam — due: 2026-04-01
- [ ] Add request-level reconnect/retry policy and make it configurable via route config — owner: alex — due: 2026-03-30
- [ ] Server keepalive / preemptive 503 if queue>threshold — owner: jordan — due: 2026-03-28
- [ ] Add distributed trace sampling for partial responses (5% baseline) + replay harness for failing traces — owner: sam — due: 2026-04-05
- [ ] Pager/oncall runbook update + weekly triage rotation for streaming incidents — owner: lia (product) + eng-sre — due: 2026-03-27
- [ ] Long-tail perf alerts (p50/p95/p99 token-times) + alert playbook — owner: meera — due: 2026-03-29

lia (product): I'll slot a 30m sync next Tue to review progress and adjust user comms. Please add any customer-impacting samples to the doc.

alex (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: adding client-visible header X-Stream-Retry and a small state machine in runtime. Patch sketch: ```js
// pseudo
if (err.isTransient && retries < MAX) { wait(backoff()); reconnect(); }
```
I'll open a PR today and link test matrix.

jordan (eng-platform): For the keepalive: current queue-length metric is noisy. I'll add a short-lived sliding window and a cap that favors new interactive streams. Will also add a metric `stream_reject_before_write` so we can measure success.

sam (eng-ml): For partial captures, I propose storing the last successful KV cache state + last token chunk to S3 with redaction. We'll rotate keys after sampling. Also adding evals to detect hallucination spikes post-changes.

meera (eng-sre): Ownership confirmations? alex/sam/jordan/lia/meera = ✅? React with :white_check_mark: if good, or comment changes.

alex (eng-runtime): ✅ PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/482 — includes retry state + unit tests. Needs perf run.

sam (eng-ml): ✅ created trace hook and temp S3 bucket: s3://rw-partial-captures-dev. Will populate with anonymized samples.

jordan (eng-platform): ✅ infra changes in staging, creating a canary with reduced concurrency to validate behavior.

meera (eng-sre): I'll draft the alert thresholds and add them to Ops dashboard. Also adding a scheduled job to run the replay harness nightly for flaky traces.

lia (product): Thanks team — I'll take care of customer notes for affected teams and surface this in next week's all-hands if remediation is on track.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in #incidents on 2026-03-30 15:00 UTC.

meera (eng-sre): Closing note: if anyone hits blocking perms for traces/S3 access ping me directly, I'll escalate. We'll regroup at the sync.
